parsed_entries.requirement: Significant data fiduciaries must be based in India.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify whether the data fiduciary is physically located in India.
parsed_entries.notes: This requirement is directly tied to the physical location of the data fiduciary.

parsed_entries.requirement: Significant data fiduciaries must undergo periodic audits.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify whether the data fiduciary has a documented audit process and schedule.
parsed_entries.notes: This requirement mandates regular audits as part of data fiduciary obligations.

parsed_entries.requirement: Significant data fiduciaries must implement such other measures, consistent with the provisions of this Act, as may be prescribed.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify whether the data fiduciary has implemented additional measures as required by the Act.
parsed_entries.notes: This requirement allows for additional measures as prescribed by the Act.

parsed_entries.requirement: The provisions of Chapter II, except sub-sections (1) and (5) of section 8, and those of Chapter III and section 16 shall not apply where—
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify whether the specific provisions of the Act are excluded from application in the specified circumstances.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applies to situations where the provisions of Chapter II and III are excluded.
parsed_entries.notes: This clause outlines exceptions to the application of certain provisions of the Act.

parsed_entries.requirement: The Chairperson and Members of the Data Protection Board must meet specific qualifications for appointment.

parsed_entries.notes: This requirement outlines the qualifications for the appointment of the Data Protection Board members.

parsed_entries.requirement: The Chairperson and Members of the Data Protection Board must receive specific salary and allowances and have a defined term of office.
